Name: Epic Epona - Horse Replacement
Author: thebigjb
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1719430332.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25532/25532-1719444828-12994998.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
May the way of the hero lead to the Triforce!

Following the creation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25346]my Zelduck mod[/url], I just had to to look for some Epona horse replacements.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2154?tab=description]The excellent one by SanguineFe[/url]﻿ (based on the Better Horses art style) is out of date and has some graphic issues. As per their creator's permissions, I created an update. This version:

[list=1]
[*]Fixes pixel miscolors.
[*]Works with 1.6+
[*]Works with the latest version of Content Patcher.
[*]Works with GMCM to let you choose your default style of Epona.
[*]Includes an Alternative Texture version if you just want to reskin.
[*][i]Should [/i]update the shop icon for your first purchase.
[/list]
This is also a a perfect pairing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22583]Epona's Song Horse Flute Sounds[/url]. (Potential collab coming.)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718914618.png[/img]

[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Alternative Textures and/or Content Patcher (depending on which version you want).
[*]Should be compatible with Horse Overhaul, but I'm not sure about the saddlebags.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718915534.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Original mod and artwork created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SanguineFe/mods?gameId=1303]SanguineFe[/url]﻿.
[*]Thanks to SerialDollface for the terrific horse art style in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1421]Better Horses[/url]﻿.
[*][i]All Legend of Zelda characters and design © Nintendo Company.[/i]
[/list]
